practice_phrases.known: She was doing the laundry yesterday.
We were doing our best to finish the project.
practice_phrases.target: 我们在做我们最大的努力来完成项目。

practice_phrases.known: He was doing everything he could to help.
practice_phrases.target: 他在做他能做的一切来帮忙。

practice_phrases.known: What were you doing when I called you this morning?
practice_phrases.target: 我今天早上给你打电话的时候你在做什么？

practice_phrases.known: I was doing some research for my presentation at that time.
practice_phrases.target: 那时候我在做一些研究为我的演讲。

practice_phrases.known: They were doing their homework when their friends came to visit them.
practice_phrases.target: 他们的朋友来拜访他们的时候他们在做作业。

practice_phrases.known: She was doing some cooking in the kitchen while he was doing the cleaning in the living room.
practice_phrases.target: 她在厨房做一些烹饪的时候他在客厅做清洁。
